description: A Java class named ThingModifySignalMapper that extends AbstractModifySignalMapper to map ThingModifyCommand objects into signals, including methods for obtaining topic path builders and enhancing payload builders.

classes.name: ThingModifySignalMapper
classes.description: A class that maps ThingModifyCommand objects to signals, extending AbstractModifySignalMapper with specific implementations for topic path and payload enhancement.

methods.name: getTopicPathBuilder
methods.description: Returns a TopicPathBuilder for a given ThingModifyCommand, constructing the topic path specific for 'things'.

methods.name: enhancePayloadBuilder
methods.description: Enhances the PayloadBuilder with the value from the ThingModifyCommand if present.
